title: Irish Stew with Peas and Zesty Twist
description: A hearty twist on a classic Irish stew, adding a burst of flavor with zesty peppers and a splash of peas.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, melt butter over medium-high heat. Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add more butter if needed, then sauté onion and zesty peppers until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in broth, scraping up browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer.
Return beef to the pot and add potatoes, carrots, thyme, and peas.
Cover pot with a lid and transfer to preheated oven. Braise for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
